paraphrase: The destruction of the faults in this life is rooted in yoga; having removed the faults that burn beings, the wise man attains safety. These are anger, exultation, wrath, greed, delusion, hypocrisy, malice, lying, gluttony, slander, envy, lust, rage, lack of self-control and lack of yoga; their removal is rooted in yoga. Freedom from anger and the rest — truthfulness, moderation, ungrudging compassion, contentment, honesty, gentleness, tranquillity, self-control, friendliness to all and non-injury — are agreed for all the orders.
